{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load and clean data (same steps as before)
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Exclude QC-failed baseline values
df = df[df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999]

# Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping highest sample_seq
df = df.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False).drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Correct batch B values
df.loc[df['assay_batch'] == 'B', 'biomarker_final'] /= 10

# Now stratify by severity and compute response rates within each severity group
df_stratified = df.groupby(['sex', 'severity', 'arm'])['responded'].mean().unstack(fill_value=0)
print('Response rate by sex, severity, and arm:')
print(df_stratified)

# Compute difference in response rate (treatment - control) within each sex-severity group
df_diff = df_stratified['treatment'] - df_stratified['control']
print('\nDifference (treatment - control) in response rate by sex and severity:')
print(df_diff)

# Compute overall sex effect on response, adjusted for severity: average difference across severity levels
sex_effect_adjusted = df_diff.groupby('sex').mean()
print('\nAverage difference (treatment - control) in response rate by sex, adjusted for severity:')
print(sex_effect_adjusted)"}
